[Device Technologies](https://www.device.com.au/) supplies hospitals, clinics, and medical professionals with advanced medical equipment, surgical tools, and health supplies. They source products from global brands to support patient care, hospital logistics, and specialized medical procedures across Australia, New Zealand, and Asia. [](https://www.device.com.au/)

- **Surgical robotics:** Provide tools for tiny, precise cuts.

- **Critical care:** Support life-saving patient monitoring.

- **Infection control:** Clean and sterilize hospital gear.

- **Cardiology:** Help treat heart and blood vessel issues. [](https://www.device.com.au/)

### Hospital Support Services

- **Logistics robots:** Move supplies inside buildings.

- **Equipment repair:** Fix and maintain broken medical tools.

- **Staff training:** Teach nurses and doctors how to use new tech. [](https://www.device.com.au/who-we-are/)
